header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: and falls asleep with his head on it. Then, when he wakes up, he finds the mount carrying his provisions beside him and becomes glad. Allah Ta'ala is more pleased than this man when His believing servant makes Tawbah.” Hazrat Abdullah (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسي ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّي تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب قبول التوبة من الذنوب ...رقم:٦٩٨٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Allah Ta'ala keeps the hand of His mercy stretched out throughout the night so that those who sinned during the day may make Tawbah at night. And He keeps the hand of His mercy stretched out throughout the day so that those who sinned during the night may make Tawbah during the day. This will continue until the sun rises from the west!” (After that, Tawbah will not be accepted.) Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ جَعَلَ بِالْمَغْرِبِ بَاباً عَرْضُهُ مَسِيرَةُ سَبْعِينَ عَاماً لِلتَّوْبَةِ لَا يُغْلَقُ حَتَّي تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو قطعة من الحديث) رواه الترمذي وقَالَ:هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في فضل التوبة رقم:٣٥٣٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “In the west, Allah Ta'ala has made a door for Tawbah; its width is a distance of seventy years' journey. That door will remain open always until the sun rises from the west.” (When it rises in the west, the Day of Qiyamah will have drawn near and the door of Tawbah will be closed.) The beloved Prophet ﷺ said this, as Hazrat Safwan ibn Assal (RA)
